mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_message (from_user_id, to_user_id, content, msg_type, send_time) VALUES (#{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{content}, #{msgType}, #{sendTime})
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.from_user_id AS fromUserId, m.to_user_id AS toUserId, m.content, m.msg_type AS msgType, m.send_time AS sendTime, fu.username AS fromUsername, fu.nickname AS fromNickname, ff.file_url AS fromAvatar, tu.username AS toUsername, tu.nickname AS toNickname, tf.file_url AS toAvatar FROM im_message m JOIN user fu ON m.from_user_id = fu.id JOIN user tu ON m.to_user_id = tu.id LEFT JOIN file ff ON fu.user_file_id = ff.id LEFT JOIN file tf ON tu.user_file_id = tf.id WHERE (fu.username = #{username1} AND tu.username = #{username2}) OR (fu.username = #{username2} AND tu.username = #{username1}) ORDER BY m.send_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
